description: TPO 150 T118 1x Oak to remove all growth overhanging tennis court.
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions: The oak tree is situated on the eastern boundary of Northwood Lawn Tennis Club grounds. It is a prominent tree in the area, and can be viewed from a number of properties on Pines Close, Kings Close, Kirby Close and Frithwood Park. The mature tree appears in good condition and has a high amenity value.

This application has been refused on the grounds that reducing the crown back to the tennis court boundary would result in a significantly unbalanced crown form and diminish the tree's overall amenity value. Although the tree is not of a maiden form, it currently has an attractive and well-proportioned crown. In our opinion, the removal of branches from only one side would have an adverse impact on its appearance and visual contribution to the area.
Having regard to the reasons given for the proposed work, the work is unjustified and will have a detrimental impact on the visual amenity and arboreal character of the area.
The removal of deadwood, dangerous / hanging branches and ivy:  This does not require the formal consent of the Council.
